summary: Cantor Equity Partners I, Inc. (CEPO), a SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing that BSTR Holdings, Inc. (Pubco) publicly filed an S-4 registration statement for a proposed business combination with BSTR Holdings (Cayman). The transaction, initially announced July 2025, includes a business combination and private placements. Closing is targeted for end of Q2 2026, subject to customary conditions. No price per share or premium is stated. CEPO will hold an extraordinary general meeting to approve the deal; shareholders are urged to read the proxy statement/prospectus. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder vote.
